nodes.summary: Let $\omega_1, \omega_2$ be $\mathbb{R}$-linearly independent complex numbers, so that they form a basis of $\mathbb{C}$ over $\mathbb{R}$. For all real numbers $t_1, t_2$, the first coordinate of $t_1 \omega_1 + t_2 \omega_2$ in this basis is $t_1$ and the second is $t_2$.
nodes.title: Coordinates in the period basis

nodes.summary: Let $\omega_1, \omega_2$ be $\mathbb{R}$-linearly independent complex numbers. The fundamental parallelogram with vertex $0$ equals the set of $z \in \mathbb{C}$ whose two coordinates in the $\mathbb{R}$-basis $\omega_1, \omega_2$ of $\mathbb{C}$ both lie in $[0, 1)$.
nodes.title: Fundamental parallelogram at the origin

nodes.summary: Let $\omega_1, \omega_2$ be $\mathbb{R}$-linearly independent complex numbers and let $\alpha \in \mathbb{C}$. The fundamental parallelogram with vertex $\alpha$ is the half-open parallelogram $\alpha + P$, where $P$ is the set of $z \in \mathbb{C}$ whose two coordinates in the $\mathbb{R}$-basis $\omega_1, \omega_2$ of $\mathbb{C}$ both lie in $[0, 1)$; that is,…
nodes.title: Fundamental parallelogram

nodes.summary: Let $\omega_1, \omega_2$ be $\mathbb{R}$-linearly independent complex numbers and let $\alpha, z \in \mathbb{C}$. Then $z$ lies in the fundamental parallelogram with vertex $\alpha$ if and only if there are real numbers $t_1, t_2$ with $0 \le t_1 < 1$ and $0 \le t_2 < 1$ such that $z = \alpha + t_1 \omega_1 + t_2 \omega_2$.
nodes.title: Membership in a fundamental parallelogram

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
